name: loom-status
description: Use when Loom seems quiet or wrong: a loom tool answers "unauthenticated", "not available" or an empty result for something the user says was saved; the session-start primer did not appear; the user asks "is loom working", "why didn't it remember", "is my token ok", or a Loom hook says `Executable not found in $PATH: "node"` or `node: not found`, or prints a `loom:` line about Node.js 18+. Checks the Node hook runtime, then runs the plugin's client check and reads its lines, so the answer names the cause (missing runtime, unreachable server, rejected or expired token, no writer grant on the write namespace, plugin or MCP entry missing, stranded captures) and the one fix. NOT for server-side operations (that is `loom doctor` on the server) and NOT for deciding what to remember (loom-memory).

findings.excerpt: brew upgrade node || brew install node
